decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds on core fabrication skills and serves utility customers, so it costs little to keep listed while its demand is still uncertain after a 2024 launch.

Public waste bins are distant from the core offer and may draw on resources, but they were only launched in 2024 and public-sector demand has not yet resolved, so the option is still worth holding for now.
Ground sleeves for posts fit the firm's metalworking base and carry low cost, so the option is kept while market response is still unclear.
The cast iron variant overlaps with the other sleeves, so some consolidation risk exists, but it is cheap to keep in a narrow portfolio while results are still uncertain.
Steel ground sleeves match the firm's core steel processing expertise, so keeping this early-stage option costs little.
